summary: Iteration 9 — Dispatcher self-service dispatch + Search/Filter + Owner weekly insights all VERIFIED end-to-end. BACKEND: 21/21 passed on /app/backend/tests/test_iteration9_dispatch_rbac_insights.py (XML: /app/test_reports/pytest/iteration9.xml). (a) Dispatcher full happy path: GET /api/staff/collection/dispatch returns rows carrying nav=/dispatch-order/{id}; GET /api/staff/orders/{id}, /api/staff/fleet, /api/staff/drivers all 200; POST assign-tm → TM_ASSIGNED, assign-driver → DRIVER_ASSIGNED, challan → READY_TO_DISPATCH, dispatch → DISPATCHED — each step persisted (verified by re-GET of /api/staff/orders/{id}). (b) RBAC: 12 parametrized tests — operator, store_manager and accountant each get 403 on assign-tm/assign-driver/challan/dispatch. Admin is NOT blocked (returns 200/409 depending on state, never 403). (c) Owner insights: GET /api/owner/insights returns {labels(7), ordered(7), delivered(7), payments(7), totals{ordered,delivered,payments}}; totals equal sum of series; dispatcher (non-owner) gets 403. Central Admin /central_admin/users renders standalone list with data-testid='staff-search' (working — typing 'Rajesh' filters list to only Rajesh Kumar, hides Anita). Status filter chips correctly HIDDEN on central users (all 13 users share badge='Active' — only 1 distinct badge, threshold is ≥2, expected behavior). Admin /admin/orders renders BOTH search box AND filter chips ['staff-filter-all','staff-filter-DELIVERED','staff-filter-DISPATCHED','staff-filter-READY TO DISPATCH'] — chips render as expected. Owner home shows 'This Week' card with real numbers (Ordered 72 m³ / Delivered 38 m³ / Received ₹31,152), a 7-day bar chart (Ordered vs Delivered) with Sun–Sat labels, and 'Payments received' sparkline row. Only console warnings are the pre-existing shadow*/pointerEvents deprecations (carryover from iterations 6-8, non-blocking). No RN red screens, no 5xx from any endpoint.

critical_code_review_comments: routers/staff.py — DISPATCH_ROLES = {DISPATCHER, ADMIN} and _dispatch_only() correctly raises 403 before any DB access on assign-tm/assign-driver/challan/dispatch (12 RBAC tests confirmed). Good.

routers/staff.py dispatch_assign_tm/dispatch_assign_driver/dispatch_challan/dispatch_dispatch mirror the owner equivalents but scope by staff plant_id via _scoped_order() — no cross-tenant leakage. Idempotent challan handling (existing-challan short-circuit) is present.
routers/staff.py:279 — 'dispatch' collection sets it['nav'] only when order.status != DELIVERED, so terminal orders don't get a chevron. Correct.

routers/owner.py:562 insights() builds 7 keys from today − 6 days .. today, sums quantity per created_at day, delivered_quantity fallback to quantity for DELIVERED orders, and payments by created_at. Totals returned match sum(series) — verified by test.

frontend/app/dispatch-order/[id].tsx passes basePath='/staff' + showProduction={false} + showInvoice={false} to OwnerDispatchPanel — verified visually that Production and Invoice CTAs do NOT render. Clean reuse.
frontend/src/screens/StaffCollection.tsx:116 searchable is gated on !embedded && !limit — so KPI-preview embedded lists (home screen) don't spam search UI, but standalone tabs do. Correct behavior.

frontend/src/screens/StaffCollection.tsx:110-114 badges set derived from allItems.badge — chips only show when set.size >= 2. Verified: admin/orders (4 badges) shows chips, central/users (1 badge 'Active') hides them.
frontend/src/components/WeeklyInsights.tsx max scaling uses Math.max(1, ...ordered, ...delivered) — guards against divide-by-zero when a fresh plant has no data. Good.
